evidence_notes: LLM reading/auditing/repair of networks is the whole study (p.1-2). Tool-free condition has the model write weights in its reply (direct_values, single reply) while the calculator condition gives a run_python tool with predict() (p.4), so mechanism is both and protocol both. Plans and scoring code were committed to a private repository before each run, 'internal pre-specification, not a public registration' (p.5, Appendix A p.12); Claude Opus 5.5 assisted with code, analyses and drafting (p.12); code at github.com/Chth1z/llm-clinical-network-audit (p.12).
